title: adb-mcp command injection in inspect_ui tool (CVE-2025-59834)
summary: adb-mcp through 0.1.0 builds adb shell command lines from unvalidated tool input (e.g. the `device` argument) and executes them via Node.js `child_process.exec`, allowing shell metacharacter injection and remote code execution on the host running the server. No fixed release was available at publication.

packages.name: adb-mcp
packages.note: No patched version at time of advisory publication; remove the server or restrict it to trusted input.
